lead_story.topic: Broncos complete comeback over Rams 30-26 on SNF — controversial PI call, Talanoa Hufanga pick-six, Matthew Stafford collapse
lead_story.headline: Broncos Rally From 16 Down, Refs Help
lead_story.research_notes: The controversial PI call on Josh Wallace is the most polarizing moment: replays show Wallace going for the ball, the INT would have sealed a Rams victory, but the flag negated it and extended Denver's game-winning drive. The stat: Stafford now owns the NFL record for most pick-6s thrown in history — he threw one tonight to give Denver the lead, then threw another desperation heave that Hufanga picked in the end zone to seal it. The collapse: Rams led 26-10 at halftime, then gave up 20 unanswered points. Bo Nix had a disastrous first half but rallied in the second — he leaped over the line on 4th down for the go-ahead TD. The Myles Garrett angle: Rams' 'super team' starts 1-2 after adding Garrett this offseason. Aaron Donald retired for two years; Stafford won MVP last season; this was supposed to be their year. Now they're reeling. The irony: Stafford manufactured a 4th-quarter comeback by throwing a pick-six to himself first. Cross-sport parallel: this has the energy of an NBA team blowing a 3-1 Finals lead.
lead_story.gif_concept: quiet resignation as the season slips away
lead_story.meme_concept: Rams with 16-point halftime lead vs. Rams in the second half after Stafford throws two pick-sixes

beats.angle: The controversial PI call that swung the game — Wallace going for the ball, Rams' INT vanishes, Denver gets life
beats.landing: Reader sees the defining injustice (or correct call, depending on fandom): one flag erased a Rams victory and handed Denver a Super Bowl lifeline.

beats.angle: Stafford's historic collapse — throws pick-six to give Denver the lead, then another INT to seal his own fate; now owns NFL record for most pick-6s in history
beats.landing: Reader realizes Stafford didn't just lose this game — he authored the blueprint for how to lose it twice in four minutes.

beats.angle: Bo Nix's second-half resurrection — leaps over the line for go-ahead TD, completes the 20-unanswered comeback after disastrous first half
beats.landing: Nix goes from disaster to clutch; the Broncos are smart, tough, complete — and 2-1.

beats.angle: The final dagger — Hufanga picks Stafford in the end zone to seal it, Rams' season officially in crisis at 1-2
beats.landing: The 'super team' experiment is failing. Garrett came for a ring; Stafford's MVP season feels like a lifetime ago. Now they're scrambling.
